title: JUVE'S OWN FANS JEERED THEM, THEN THEY BEAT 10-MAN NAPOLI 2-0
description:
Jeered by their own fans, then two goals later it's a win. Juventus 2-0 Napoli had everything.

Juve had won just one of their last four league games, and the fans let them hear about it. Then Kerim Alajbegovic scored in the 70th minute. Five minutes after that, Napoli's Luca Marianucci picked up a second yellow, so Napoli were a goal down and a man down. Jeremie Boga made it two in the 87th minute, and Spalletti could finally breathe.

Napoli are tenth now, with four league defeats. Nobody in Naples calls that a plan.

Were the jeers fair, or did Juve's fans pick the wrong night? Tell us which side you're on.
